first-idea.name: Ka manaʻo mua
first-idea.line: Ka kamaʻilio mua loa, ma mua o ka loaʻa ʻana o kekahi code.
first-board.name: Ka papa mua
first-board.line: He papa e nānā ana i kona kūkulu ponoʻī: nā kāleka, nā kolamu, huki a kau, nā papahana.
team-roles.name: Pūʻulu a me nā kuleana
team-roles.line: Nā ʻano mea hana, nā kumu hoʻohālike pūʻulu, nā wahi a me ka mea nāna e hana i ka aha.
install.name: Kau a me nā hoʻokuʻu
install.line: He zip hiki i ke hoaaloha ke kau, hōʻano hou ponoʻī, nā kahawai a me ka hoʻi.
usage-saver.name: Mālama hoʻohana
usage-saver.line: E ana i ke kumukūʻai o nā holo, mālama i ke code i māmā, mālama i kou palena.
friends.name: Nā hoaaloha a me ke kaʻana like
friends.line: Nā DM pilikino, he relay hūnā ʻia, nā kono, nā kuleana a me nā papahana i kaʻana like ʻia.
languages.name: Nā ʻōlelo
languages.line: Kēlā me kēia kikokikona pale ma kahi waihona ʻōlelo, me ka Holani a me ka Flemish ma mua.
ai-tester.name: Mea hoʻāʻo AI
ai-tester.line: Nānā ka mea hoʻāʻo i kēlā me kēia hāʻawi ma mua a hōʻike i kāna i ʻike ai.
website.name: Ka pūnaewele
website.line: aigile.lol, ka teaser a me kēia laina manawa.
streaming.name: Kamaʻilio a me ka kahe
streaming.line: Discord, Twitch, OBS, ke ʻano kahe, GIF a me emoji.
no-ai.name: Mana AI ʻole
no-ai.line: He papa no ka poʻe hoʻopaʻa code me ka AI ʻole, a me nā papa lehulehu.
night-watch.name: Kiaʻi pō
night-watch.line: Mālama ke kiaʻi a me ka Scrum Master i nā pūʻulu ma ka hana i kou hiamoe ʻana.
p-more.name: Nā mea ʻē aʻe a pau
p-more.line: Nā manaʻo liʻiliʻi e kali ana i ko lākou wā.
p-android.name: Kelepona a me Android
p-android.line: E hōʻea i kāu papa mai kahi kelepona, a laila he ʻapp Android maoli.
p-release.name: Alpha a ma hope aku
p-release.line: Alpha pani ʻia, ka pūnaewele ola, a laila beta.
p-languages.name: Nā ʻōlelo hou aʻe
p-languages.line: Ma luna o hoʻokahi haneli ʻōlelo, a me ke ʻano hoʻokomo piha no ka poʻe aʻo.
p-engines.name: Nā ʻenekini AI hou aʻe
p-engines.line: E koho iā Claude, Codex a i ʻole Gemini no kēlā me kēia mea hana.
p-pro.name: Hana loea
p-pro.line: Nā lepili pilikia, nā puka hoʻohui, nā kāleka hanana a me nā pale.
p-self.name: Ka mālama ʻana iā ʻoe
p-self.line: Ke ʻano luhi, nā hoʻomanaʻo mālama iā ʻoe iho a me 4:20.
p-servers.name: Nā kikowaena a me ka nui
p-servers.line: Nā hoʻonohonoho kikowaena āpau, nā kuleana a me ka hoʻolālā ulu.
p-livestream.name: Nā mea hou o ka kahe
p-livestream.line: Ke kamaʻilio Twitch, nā emoji ponoʻī a me kahi nānā ola lehulehu.
